_doc: Passages the Good_Calmet edition moved: a Good page (crops.json key) that also holds the text of these source pages, out of their order. good_calmet_kraken.crops() adds them to the record as moved; good_notes.py pairs the notes of those pages in Good's order; the review editor shows the Good page on them.

01_Genèse_1-2/page_0159.why: Gen 1:6-8 (the firmament, the heavens): source 105-106 come after 103-104 (Gen 1:2); Good rewrote and shortened them, before 103-104 (Good 160). Good 159 notes (f)-(s): Genef. I. 6 ... II. Cor. XII. 2.
